title: Skin-in-the-Game: Decision Making via Multi-Stakeholder Alignment in LLMs
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study. The main finding is that the proposed Skin-in-the-Game (SKIG) framework significantly enhances general moral reasoning in LLMs compared to baseline methods.
